title: Morer advancements
description: More advancements, need I say more?
body:
Very Stylish: Obtain all armor trims

To The Place I Belong: Craft a recovery compass

Big Cloud: Ride a happy ghast

Bad Breath: Brew a lingering potion

Builder's Friend: Craft scaffolding

Heavy Equipment: Take 20 damage from a falling anvil/dripstone

Acquired Taste: Eat chorus fruit

Mitosis: Give amethyst to an allay

Petrifying: Encouter a zoglin

It Summons: Encouter a warden

Alien Allays: Encouter a vex

Cave Diver: Enter a dripstone/lush cave

Lava Bath: Put lava in a cauldron

They Grow Up So Fast: Obtain a turtle scute

Scaly Snorkel: Craft a turtle shell

Kaboom?: Light a creeper up

Adoor-able: Obtain a copper door

Guardian's Curse: Get cursed by an elder guardian

Who Needs Charges?: Kill a mob with a wind burst mace

Weird Hybrid: Encouter a mule

Portable Pockets: Craft a shulker box

Underwater Beacon: Construct a conduit

Its Right Behind Me: Encouter a creaking
